The '''Graadorians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who developed an [[Farm/Legends|agrarian]] society on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Graador]]. Located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], the Graadorians' [[Planet/Legends|planet]] came to share its name with the [[Graador sector/Legends|Graador sector]]. The Graadorians drew scant attention from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the ruling authority in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], and for that reason, their homeworld was identified as a possible sanctuary for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Fleet]]; however, the presence of sentient, [[mutant mynock]]s and [[Exogorth/Legends|space slugs]] dissuaded the Rebel [[operative]]s who [[Mission to Graador|investigated]] the planet.

==Biology and appearance==
The Graadorians were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="RECG" />

==History==
[[File:Mynock_NEGAS.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A mutant form of mynock inhabited Graador.]]
The Graadorians evolved on [[Graador]],<ref name="RECG" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Graador system/Legends|Graador system]] of the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was riddled with vast [[Cave/Legends|caverns]], and while it was capable of supporting life, the planet contained little in the way of resources that the Graadorians could exploit. The Graadorians, therefore, developed an [[Farm/Legends|agrarian]] society.<ref name="RECG" /> The [[Realspace/Legends|space]] around the Graadorians' homeworld was explored between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and it eventually became integrated into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as the [[Graador sector/Legends|Graador sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

During the [[Time/Legends|period]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Graadorians' homeworld was also populated by colossal [[Exogorth/Legends|space slugs]] and a species of [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] who had mutated and achieved sentience; the [[mutant mynock]]s were able to control the space slugs. At that time, the ruling power of the galaxy, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], paid little heed to Graadorian society. For that reason, after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Mission to Graador|dispatched]] several [[operative]]s to Graador to scope out the planet as a possible refuge. The operatives initially approved Graador as suitable for the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], but they reconsidered once they uncovered that the sentient mynocks and their space slug thralls posed a threat to the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="RECG" />

By [[137 ABY]], the Graadorians' homeworld was part of the pan-galactic territory controlled by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Graadorians were created for the ''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]'', co-authored by [[Rodney Thompson]], [[Sterling Hershey]], [[Owen K.C. Stephens|Owen Stephens]], and [[J.D. Wiker]], and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2009]].
